node.title: Re: inconsistent module access
node.author: choroba
node.doctext:
I can get the weird behaviour if I use [metamod://IO::All] without running its import, i.e. using use IO::All ();

or using [doc://require] instead of [doc://use].

Another way to skip the import is to redefine it: sub IO::All::import {} use IO::All;

Without seeing the actual code, I'm not sure I can help you more.
